Title Ideas (pick one)

“Turn Your Thoughts Into Cash: Make Faceless YouTube Videos With AI”

“How I Turn Random Thoughts Into Money‑Making Videos (Step‑By‑Step)”

“Stop Overthinking, Start Earning: Use AI To Build a YouTube Channel”

Video Script for InVideo (Voiceover + Visual Prompts)

You can paste this as the script text in Video AI. The bits in brackets [VISUAL] are for scene guidance; the rest is narration.

SCENE 1 – HOOK (0:00 – 0:25)

[VISUAL] Fast montage: people scrolling on their phone, a blank notebook, then rising YouTube analytics, money icons, AI/tech graphics.

VOICEOVER:

Have you ever had a brilliant idea in the shower…
…and watched it disappear before you even dried off?

What if every random thought, every late‑night note in your phone,
could be turned into a video that makes you money while you sleep?

In this video, I’m going to show you how to turn your thoughts into YouTube videos using AI—
even if you hate being on camera and have zero editing skills.

SCENE 2 – INTRO & PROMISE (0:25 – 1:00)

[VISUAL] Calm, clean background, AI graphics, stock footage of someone working on a laptop.

VOICEOVER:

Welcome back to the channel.
Today we’re breaking down a simple system:

Capture your thoughts

Turn them into a clear message

Use AI to build a full video

Publish and monetize

By the end of this video, you’ll know exactly how to go from “I have ideas”
to “I have videos that can earn me money.”

SCENE 3 – THE PROBLEM (1:00 – 2:00)

[VISUAL] People looking stressed, plenty of tabs open, endless to‑do lists, social media overload.

VOICEOVER:

Most of us are not short on ideas.
We’re short on systems.

We overthink.
We tell ourselves:

“I don’t know where to start.”
“I’m not good on camera.”
“I don’t have time to learn editing.”

So our ideas stay in our heads, or buried in our notes app,
while other people make content, grow audiences, and get paid.

The truth?
You don’t need to be a video editor…
You don’t need to show your face…
and you don’t need a studio.

You just need a way to organize your thoughts
and let AI do the heavy lifting.

SCENE 4 – MINDSET SHIFT: YOUR THOUGHTS ARE ASSETS (2:00 – 3:00)

[VISUAL] Brain turning into lightbulbs, then lightbulbs turning into graphs/money icons, people watching videos on phones.

VOICEOVER:

Here’s the mindset shift:

Your thoughts are assets—
but only if you capture them and share them.

Every lesson you’ve learned,
every mistake you’ve made,
every trick that makes your life easier…

Someone out there is searching for that right now on YouTube.

They’re typing things like:

“How do I stay motivated?”

“How do I stop procrastinating?”

“How can I make money online?”

“How do I improve my relationships, my mindset, my health?”

If you can take your thoughts and turn them into clear, helpful videos,
you’re not just “making content”—
you’re building a library of assets that can pay you month after month.

SCENE 5 – STEP 1: CAPTURE YOUR THOUGHTS (3:00 – 3:45)

[VISUAL] Phone notes app, voice memo, a person jotting in a notebook, quick cuts.

VOICEOVER:

Step one is capture.

From now on, don’t trust your brain to remember your ideas.

Use:

Your phone’s notes app

A simple notebook

Or a voice memo

Whenever you think:

“That’s interesting.”
“I wish someone had told me this earlier.”
“I keep giving this same advice to people…”

Write it down.

Don’t worry about being organized.
Just get it out of your head.

Later, you’ll turn those messy notes into clear video ideas.

SCENE 6 – STEP 2: TURN THOUGHTS INTO VIDEO IDEAS (3:45 – 4:45)

[VISUAL] On‑screen text: “Thought → Topic → Title”, then simple diagrams.

VOICEOVER:

Now we go from thoughts to topics.

Look at your notes and ask two questions:

What problem does this help with?

Who is this really for?

Example:

Thought: “I always procrastinate until the last minute.”

Problem: Procrastination / lack of focus

Who: Students, creatives, entrepreneurs

Now you can turn that into a video idea:

“How To Stop Procrastinating in 3 Simple Steps”

Or:

Thought: “I used AI to turn my ideas into a YouTube video.”

Problem: People don’t know how to start a channel

Who: Beginners, people with no editing skills

That becomes:

“How To Use AI To Create YouTube Videos Without Filming Yourself”

That’s what we’re doing in this video right now.

SCENE 7 – STEP 3: WRITE A SIMPLE SCRIPT WITH AI (4:45 – 6:15)

[VISUAL] Screen recording style: text appearing, an AI interface, typing, then a structured script.

VOICEOVER:

Once you have a topic, it’s script time.

You don’t need to write a Hollywood screenplay.
You just need a clear, simple structure:

Hook – get their attention

Problem – show you understand

Solution – share your steps or story

Call to action – what to do next

You can write this yourself,
or you can use AI to help you draft it faster.

Feed your main idea and 2–3 key points into an AI writing tool,
and ask it to create a YouTube script in your tone.
Then edit it so it sounds like you.

That’s exactly how this script is structured:
a real human idea… streamlined with AI.

SCENE 8 – STEP 4: TURN THE SCRIPT INTO A VIDEO (6:15 – 7:30)

[VISUAL] Show an abstract “AI video tool” interface, timeline filling up with clips, stock footage of people editing.

VOICEOVER:

Now the fun part: turning words into video.

This is where AI video tools come in.

Instead of:

Filming yourself

Buying a camera

Learning complicated editing software

You paste your script into an AI video generator,
choose a style, add a voiceover—
and it builds the video for you using stock clips, images, and text.

You can create:

Faceless motivational videos

Explainer videos

Tutorial‑style content

Storytime or narrative videos

Your job becomes:

Having ideas

Shaping those ideas into messages

Letting the AI handle visuals and timing

This means you can create more videos, more consistently…
which is exactly what YouTube rewards.

SCENE 9 – MONETIZATION: HOW THIS BECOMES MONEY (7:30 – 8:30)

[VISUAL] YouTube analytics, monetization icons, ad symbol, affiliate links, digital products.

VOICEOVER:

So how does this actually turn into money?

There are a few main paths:

YouTube Ad Revenue
Once your channel hits the requirements for monetization,
your videos can start earning from ads.

Affiliate Links
You can recommend tools, books, or products you genuinely use
and earn a commission when viewers buy through your link.

Digital Products or Services
Over time, your content builds trust.
That makes it easier to sell ebooks, courses, coaching, templates—
anything that helps your audience more deeply.

Think of every video as a tiny digital worker—
sharing your ideas, helping people,
and eventually bringing money back to you.

SCENE 10 – KEEP IT REAL (8:30 – 9:15)

[VISUAL] Authentic, relatable footage: imperfect desk, someone working late but smiling, sunrise, city time‑lapse.

VOICEOVER:

One important reminder:

AI is a tool, not a replacement for you.

The power comes from your real experiences, your real perspective.

AI can:

Make the process faster

Help you structure your thoughts

Turn text into visuals

But only you can decide what matters,
what you stand for,
and how honest and helpful you’re willing to be.

That’s what people actually connect with—
and that’s what keeps them coming back to your channel.

SCENE 11 – RECAP & CALL TO ACTION (9:15 – 10:00)

[VISUAL] Simple bullet list recap on screen. Then end card with “Subscribe” and “Watch next” suggestions.

VOICEOVER:

Let’s recap the system:

Capture your thoughts – never trust your brain to remember

Turn thoughts into topics – who does this help, and how?

Write a simple script – hook, problem, solution, call to action

Use AI to build the video – faceless, fast, and consistent

Monetize – ads, affiliates, and digital products over time

If you’re ready to stop letting your ideas fade away
and start turning them into real videos,
this is your sign to begin today.

If you found this helpful,
hit the like button,
subscribe for more content on using AI and creativity to build your income,
and drop a comment telling me what video you’re going to create next.

Thanks for watching,
and I’ll see you in the next one.
